NOCTILUCENCE

Words in light. Noctilucence is User1's name for it: sound shining in the dark, as noctilucent clouds shine after sunset.

Each word as Ecouter would say it:
≋
Along the strip, its sounds in light, in the order they are spoken. Colour is pitch, from red at the low end to violet at the high. Height says pitch again. Brightness is strength. Sparks are hiss.
◎
At the right, the wall it strikes, ring by ring. Each ring is born at the centre at its own moment, spreads, slows, and fades. The last in is the last out, and when the air falls silent the wall is dark again.
✺
Each ring is shaped by its formants. A narrow chord, as in aa or oo, makes a few broad lobes. A wide one, as in ee, makes many fine points. A hiss is a burr.
✛
Read the wall along its four slits, above, below, left, and right of the centre. The centre is the most recent sound.
▷
Each picture plays once, silent, as it comes into view. Click it to hear the word, at the speed chosen above, in step with its picture.
§
Drawn by words/teardown.js from Ecouter's phones.js, and voiced by its voicebox.js. Phonemes come from CMUdict, or, where CMUdict has no entry, from the rules of NRL Report 7948 (1976).
